description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford attempted to deliver a few lines in French while speaking at a Chamber of Commerce of Metropolitan Montreal event on Tuesday. He later told the crowd the thought of speaking French stressed him out so much he was 'up all night.'
title: Ford apologizes for 'poor' French

author: Erin DeBooy
description: Drunk driving charges against a woman were stayed after an investigating RCMP officer appeared to have deliberately withheld information about his romantic relationship with a key witness, a Manitoba judge ruled.
title: Manitoba judge stays charge in 'rare' decision after Mountie failed to disclose relationship with key witness

author: Akshay Kulkarni
description: A Surrey, B.C., landscaping company is giving its employees the day off on Thursday when the much-hyped Grand Theft Auto VI video game finally releases, in what has been billed as perhaps the biggest entertainment launch ever.
title: Grand Theft Auto VI release means Surrey, B.C., landscaping company employees get the day off

description: Traffic was temporarily suspended over the Crimean Bridge after ‌an attack, Sergei Aksyonov, Crimea's Russian-installed governor, said on Telegram on Thursday, adding ​that assessment of the ​damage was underway.
title: Crimea bridge attacked again, Russian governor says

author: Jeff Lagerquist
description: Anthropic has set a stock price of $83 US per share for its hotly anticipated initial public offering, with shares of the U.S. artificial intelligence giant set to debut on the Nasdaq exchange on Thursday.
title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 US per share, valuing AI giant at $1.51 trillion US

author: Jeremy Warren
description: Saskatchewan's First Nations Health Ombudsperson is investigating how a Regina boy lost his small intestine after a routine surgery for appendicitis.
title: First Nations health watchdog investigating how Sask. boy lost use of small intestine after routine surgery

author: Ronald Blum
description: Major League Baseball commissioner Rob Manfred says team owners will not move off their demand for a salary cap, leaving the sport on track for a lockout starting Dec. 2 that could threaten the 2027 season.
title: MLB commissioner says owners won't compromise on salary cap, leaving sport headed to lockout

author: Sheena Goodyear
description: Mia Latter has decided to waive her legal right to anonymity and speak publicly about her teenage relationship with disgraced actor Russell Brand. She's calling for changes to the U.K.'s age-of-consent laws.
title: She says Russell Brand sexually assaulted her when she was 16. She's waiving her anonymity to speak out

author: Catherine Garrett
description: A second landslide and train derailment into the Skeena River in eight months has reignited calls by the Gitxsan Huwilp Government to immediately stop train hauling in the vicinity of its traditional territory.
title: Gitxsan hereditary chiefs call for halt to rail cargo as diesel leaks from train derailment along river in B.C.

author: Murray Brewster
description: The Canadian military has suspended most weekend cadet training and competitions in parts of the country until March, citing budget restraint. Leaked emails reveal mounting financial pressures despite billions in new defence spending.
title: Cadets being told to stand down as Canada spends billions on defence

author: Patricia Kozicka
description: Bishop’s University in Sherbrooke, Que., has decided to cut its women’s varsity rugby team. The news comes as Canada’s women’s rugby team ranks third in the world, and university varsity teams are a pipeline to fuel the national team roster.
title: Women's rugby players fight to save team after Bishop's University cuts varsity program

description: The Competition Bureau is moving ahead with an investigation into whether clothing giants Gap and Old Navy are violating marketing regulations by making potentially false or misleading claims in their advertising.
title: Competition Bureau examining marketing practices by Gap, Old Navy

author: John Mazerolle
description: The U.S., Bolivia and Mexico lost their measles elimination status this week, as Canada did this time last year. What would it take for Canada to regain its status?
title: What it will take for Canada to regain its measles elimination status

author: Greg Colgan
description: The return of the Canada Strong Pass is getting mixed reviews. The pass will come back for a third year as Parks Canada is intending to lay off 517 full-time positions, and Banff National Park hit a record 4.5 million visitors.
title: Parks Canada budget cuts, tourism growth raise concerns for Canada Strong Pass return

author: Alyssa Wheeler
description: More than 285,000 people have signed a petition asking the federal government to remove U.S. Ambassador Pete Hoekstra from Canada.
title: Nearly 300,000 people sign petition demanding U.S. Ambassador Pete Hoekstra's removal

author: Olivia Piercey
description: A probe targeting what police are calling an organized crime ring linked to Toronto's towing industry has led to 21 arrests, including the group's alleged leader, investigators say.
title: 21 arrested in alleged Toronto-area towing industry crime ring investigation: police

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: A beloved hippopotamus named Fiona is on 24-hour medical watch after eating a hat that was tossed into her enclosure.
title: Fiona, the hippo famous for surviving, is on 24-hour medical watch after eating a hat

description: Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries on Wednesday to be speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives, as he brushed past skeptics and was on track to make history as the country's first Black American with the gavel.
title: Hakeem Jeffries poised to become 1st Black U.S. House Speaker, after internal vote by Democrats

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: Dozens competed in a Nathan Fielder lookalike contest in Toronto on Tuesday, taking on business pitches, a staring contest and an improvised conversation with an Elizabeth Holmes impersonator.
title: Nathan Fielder lookalike contest crowns a deadpan winner

description: A CBC News analysis found at least a dozen international sports federations have quietly welcomed Russian athletes back to compete. It comes after the International Olympic Committee decided to start rolling back bans that were put in place following Russia's
title: Russia can’t compete at the World Juniors. What about other sports?

description: Waymo has temporarily stopped offering driverless taxi rides on freeways after California banned the vehicles from state freeways following recent traffic incidents.
title: Waymo temporarily pulls robotaxis from U.S. highways

description: China's President Xi Jinping on Wednesday pledged to stand up against trade protectionism, while his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin criticized Western sanctions as the two set the stage for a high-stakes trilateral meeting with ‌U.S. President Donald Trump.
title: Xi, Putin meet in China, ahead of summit with Trump

description: Cape Breton Regional Municipality say 17 people were reported injured in the early morning incident, and it's not clear yet if there were any fatalities.
title: Apartment building collapses after explosion, fire in Glace Bay, N.S.

description: Any lingering thoughts of qualifying for the 2028 Olympic debut of flag football will be in the rearview mirror this weekend by members of Canada’s national women’s team in Chula Vista, Calif., where 24 players will open a training camp to begin the road to Los Angeles.
title: Football Canada launches Road to LA28 with first camps for Olympic-bound men's, women's flag teams

author: Jonathan Ore
description: Beyond an impossibly lavish presentation, the latest Grand Theft Auto game is mostly a familiar formula with some smart additions — and for the vast majority of players, it's exactly what they've been waiting for.
title: Grand Theft Auto VI is a spectacular, cynical and sometimes shallow joyride through the American psyche

author: Collin Gallant
description: As Canada boosts its military spending, officials in Medicine Hat, Alta., are seeking out new investment and economic activity tied to new private sector engagement by the Canadian Forces at CFB Suffield.
title: Medicine Hat, Alta., seeks to become 'drone city' as defence dollars roll in

description: SNL’s ‘Sister’ sketch went viral after it satirized the toll that caregiving for aging parents can play, particularly on women. CBC’s Nick Logan breaks down the stats behind caregiving in Canada and why some viewers said the sketch hit hard.
title: Why SNL’s ‘Sister’ sketch felt too real

author: Anand Ram
description: Voyager 1, already the farthest a human-made object has ever gone, has crossed the arbitrary but important threshold of a light day. It now takes 24 hours to send a message to the probe, now in interstellar space.
title: The new milestone Voyager 1 just crossed in interstellar space

description: Prime Minister Mark Carney on Wednesday said that Canada 's growing trade relations with China are not a top priority for U.S. President Donald Trump, pointing out that Canada primarily exports commodities to China rather than
title: Carney to meet with Trump at APEC, says Canada's trade ties with China are not U.S. president's top concern

author: John Harris
description: Body cameras can be a valuable source of evidence for the justice system, but it gives legal professionals a lot of extra footage to review. The head of the province’s Crown Attorney Association says there’s not enough resources for prosecutors to process body camera footage.
title: Body cam footage could overload the justice system, warns senior Crown prosecutor

author: Ryan Cooke
description: Justice Vikas Khaladkar roundly rejected a bail proposal from a man who texted the sister of his former intimate partner, saying: "I’ll get bail. This is Canada. She’ll be with me by the end of the day.”
title: ‘Not anymore’: N.L. judge denies bail to man who bragged about Canada's easy release

author: Geoff Nixon
description: Recent episodes have shone a light on the ongoing threat to companies — and by extension, the wider economy — from efforts to surreptitiously steal information and secrets. These include efforts involving state or state-linked actors.
title: Theft of trade, tech secrets 'a global issue' extending beyond recent headlines: security CEO
